method: Both native SDKs: Bazel -c opt, cross-crate ThinLTO; native C++ Release -O3. Comparator retains upstream opt-level=z, full LTO, one codegen unit. All timed processes pinned to CPU 0, reverse host order in alternating rounds; no concurrent builds/profiles. Optimized bytecode warm/cold controls; fixed-work diagnostic runs identical source on each host. Median per invocation, then median across invocations. Full suite asserts native/TS equality internally before timing. Sampling profiles collected separately.

sdkAbiDiagnostic.method: One shipped SDK; alternate exact {} fast path and whitespace empty JSON slow path. CPU 0 pinned, 500,000 create/destroy operations per tag/encoding/round; same success/non-null checks. Diagnostic excludes Hermes allocations and GC.

notes: Earlier four-host pilot showed cold diverse-tag regression; retained in full rather than discarded. Final calibrated runs and separate fixed-work runs improve. Run-to-run and GC variance limit low-percent claims.
Warm construction uses unchanged 64-entry JS cache, so this Rust fast path primarily helps cache misses and long tags.
Cold diverse construction remains slower than optimized magrinj; correctness and pinned ICU4C/J/X/Test262 coverage remain required.
